sentences: We have externally validated science-based emissions reductions targets that guide how we decarbonize our business through alternative energy solutions, clean and renewable energy sources and collaborating with our suppliers.

Our strategy centers on expanding clean and renewable energy (96% coverage across its retail IBX data centers in 2025), implementing energy efficiency initiatives ($36M invested in 2025), piloting low-carbon energy solutions and collaborating with suppliers to address embodied carbon across our value chain.
We have SBTi-approved targets to reach net-zero by 2040.
